title: Quietly Smoky Japanese Tofu Casserole
description: A peppery and creamy Japanese dish featuring duck sauce, perfect for a date night, originating from the Chubu region, this ovo-vegetarian friendly casserole is wood-fired baked to perfection.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together duck sauce, soy sauce, and sesame oil.
Add the cubed tofu to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce mixture.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and smoked paprika.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of the sauce coated tofu.
Pour the egg mixture over the tofu layer.
Sprinkle the shredded mozzarella cheese and chopped green onions over the egg layer.
Bake the casserole in the preheated wood-fired oven for 35 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
